title: Report a task's outcome, most specific failure first

blocks.text: Catch blocks are evaluated in order, top to bottom, and the first one whose type matches wins. So the more specific types go first and the most general last.
Write `TaskRunner.run(Callable<String> task)`. It calls the task and returns one line:
Report exceptions, and only exceptions: not everything that can be thrown is one.

cases.says: A task that completes is reported with its result.
An IOException is reported as an I/O failure.
Any other exception is reported as a plain failure.
A FileNotFoundException, a subclass of IOException, gets its own report, so its catch comes first.
An Error is not an Exception: it must reach the caller instead of being reported.

concepts: Catch blocks are evaluated in order from top to bottom, and the first matching one handles the exception.
